deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corp. (TSE:4689) made an offer to acquire an additional 18.6% stake in Yume No Machi Souzou Iinkai Co. for approximately ¥1.28 billion in cash on February 21, 2007. Under the offer, Yahoo Japan will increase its stake from 23.24% to 41.84%, by purchasing an additional 3,200 shares for ¥401,190 each. Index Holdings (JASDAQ:4835), which holds 3,200 Yume No Machi shares, has agreed to sell its entire stake in Yume No Machi Souzou Iinkai Co. The tender offer period will last from March 1 to April 2, 2007.

Culture Convenience Club Co., Ltd. (TSE: 4756) agreed to acquire 30.21% stake in Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd (OSE: 2484) from Yahoo Japan Corp. (TSE: 4689) for ¥1.3 billion on March 26, 2009. Culture Convenience Club Co., Ltd. will acquire 0.02 million shares for ¥78181.82 per share. The transaction is expected to close by March 31, 2009.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) agreed to acquire 52.17% stake in Carview Corporation (TSE:2155) from SOFTBANK CORP. (TSE:9984) for ¥3 billion On December 7, 2012. Yahoo Japan Corporation will acquire 0.03 million shares of Carview Corporation. Board of Directors of Carview decided to promote Masayoshi Ohnishi as President and Representative Director from Vice President, Director of Personnel Division, Director of Administrative Division, Director of Financial and Accounting Division and Director of Foreign Business Development Division of Carview and Shoichi Kaneko will become Director of Carview from earlier position of President and Representative Director.

The transaction was resolved by the Board of Directors of Yahoo Japan Corporation. The transaction was approved by the Board of Directors of SOFTBANK CORP. The impact of the consolidation of Carview on SOFTBANK CORP's consolidated and non-consolidated performances in the current fiscal year is expected to be minor. The share purchase agreement will be signed on December 10, 2012 and the deal is expected to close on December 17, 2012. As of January 18, 2013, Carview Corporation decided to have Yutaka Hyodo as President and Representative Director, Hiroyasu Otsuka as Director, and Masayuki Takata as Director on February 8, 2013. Ken Miyauchi, Director of Carview, will resign at the conclusion of the February 8, 2013 Extraordinary Shareholders' meeting. Shingo Yoshii will be recruited as auditor and Takashi Okubo will resign as auditor at the conclusion of the February 8, 2013 Extraordinary Shareholders' meeting. Tokyo Kyodo Accounting Office acted as accountant for Yahoo Japan Corporation. Katsumi Aya and Shunsuke Uruga of Tokiwa Law Office acted as legal advisor for Yahoo Japan Corporation.

Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:2484) acquired Satsuma Ebisu-do Co., Ltd from Takayo Matsumoto and other sellers for approximately ¥760 million in cash on May 17, 2013. Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. acquired 160 shares. Takayo Matsumoto sold its 140 shares. Following the completion of the deal, Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. will operate Satsuma Ebisu-do Co., Ltd as its subsidiary. For the year ending April 2012, Satsuma Ebisu-do Co., Ltd had net assets of ¥263.44 million, total assets of ¥573.58 million, sales of ¥1.93 billion, operating income of ¥70.41 million, recurring income of ¥72.47 million, and current net income of ¥42.79 million. The Board of Directors of Yume no Machi Souzou passed a resolution for the transaction on May 17, 2013. An amount of ¥25 million will be paid as advisory fee.

Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:2484) signed a basic agreement to acquire ZEN Co. Ltd. from Akira Shibata and 2 other individuals for on November 26, 2013. Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. is acquiring 200 shares of ZEN Co. Ltd. Akira Shibata is selling 151 shares representing 75.5% stake. The transaction has been resolved by Board of Directors of Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. Signing of the share transfer agreement and expected closing of the transaction is due in late December 2013.

deals.sellers: Microsoft Corporation (NasdaqGS:MSFT); Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. (TSE:8511)
deals.comment:
Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) made an offer to acquire remaining 46.81% stake in Carview Corporation (TSE:2155) from Japan Securities Finance Co. Ltd. (TSE:8511), Microsoft Corporation, Saburo Kikuchi, Motoi Matsumotofor, Shoichi Kaneko and others for ¥5 billion on October 22, 2014. The consideration includes acquisition of 5.7 million shares and 2,740 options. Yahoo Japan Corporation will acquire shares at ¥863 per share for approximately 5.66 million ordinary shares. Minimum number of shares scheduled to be purchased are 2.06 million shares. If Yahoo is unable to acquire all of the common shares, then two step purchases will be made and will make Carview, a wholly owned subsidiary. Yahoo received an approval from Microsoft Corporation to the effect that it has intention to subscribe to the tender offer for the shares held directly and indirectly by the same.

On October 22, 2014, Board of Directors Carview Corporation unanimously approved the offer. The offering period is from October 23, 2014 to December 8, 2014. Carview established a 3rd party committee comprising of independent members. Settlement starts on December 15, 2014. Nomura Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor and Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu acted as legal advisor for Yahoo Japan. A.G.S. Consulting Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor and City-Yuwa Partners acted as legal advisor for Carview. The purchase commission fee of Nomura Securities is ¥70 million and other fee of Nomura Securities is ¥4 million. Masahisa Ikeda of Shearman & Sterling LLP acted as legal advisor to Yahoo Japan Corporation.

LINE Corporation (TSE:3938) entered into an ordinary share transfer agreement to acquire 22% stake in Yume no Machi Souzou Iinkai Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:2484) from Kito Planning Y.K. and Tetsuya Ichimura an existing shareholders for ¥4 billion on October 13, 2016. LINE will acquire 2.2 million shares out of which Kito Planning Y.K. will sell its 1.32 million share and Tetsuya Ichimura will sell its 0.9 million shares. The deal is expected to close by October 14, 2016. The deal was approved by the Board of Directors of LINE. The impact of the acquisition on LINE's consolidated results for the current term is not expected to be material.
